[/size][/font][/list][font=Arial][size=3]I have yet to test it on Mac or Linux; let me know if it works, I'm pretty sure it should. Same goes for multiplayer!

This is my first mod! Please let me know if there are any bugs or incompatible mods (most other Greenhouse mods will be incompatible by default!). I made this because none of the current mods are quite what I was looking for.
